result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection adjacent to a large commercial facility. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like marked continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and signals are present, the excessive crossing distance and lack of median refuges create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must traverse multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, significantly increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching or turning drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised median islands to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the environment is dominated by wide multi-lane roadways and large corner radii that prioritize vehicle throughput and increase pedestrian exposure time.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and center.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radii
hazards.description: The wide design of the corners allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners where the crosswalks meet the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane or unused road space to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.
